name: Boot Splash & Animation
description: Generate a boot splash and a boot animation, then package them as exist: an Android bootanimation.zip (desc.txt + PNG frames, stored uncompressed) and a Plymouth theme for the x86_64 ISO. Frames are painted here, not downloaded, so the result works on a machine with no image tools.

panels.title: Boot Splash & Animation
panels.subtitle: Paint a splash, animate it, package for Android or Plymouth
